description: Access to systems, applications, or accounts is permitted without requiring multi-factor authentication. This signal indicates that authentication relies solely on a single factor (typically a password) without additional verification mechanisms.
applicability: Applicable to any system requiring user authentication, including cloud consoles, VPN access, remote administration, privileged accounts, and applications handling sensitive data. Particularly relevant for network access and privileged account access.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of identity provider configurations, conditional access policies, authentication settings, and MFA enrollment status for users and service accounts.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
